column1: # MANT-UNGL (9 Oct 2026): Loc. 694/09 file 0233 (pp.176-177, clerk hand). Two blind Sonnet passes agree on every code. r03 '4.10.11.2' is followed by '20' with an 'm' above it, then 'risdales' (worker zoom): the clear numeral '20 m[ille] risdales', not a code, so it is left out. Isolated codes r01 83 ('couronne de Suede. 83 donc a donne'), r02 93 ('promet a 93'), r04 59 ('ches Gyque 59 a intercepte'), r05 93 + r06 75 ('de 93 a 75', right page). No interlinear letters.
